name: mcp-asset-register
description: MCP server for a fixed asset register with depreciation schedules. A fixed asset register that depreciates on the rates the tax authorities actually publish, with the schedule, the journal and the gain on sale.

settings.name: mcp.zovo.one token
settings.description: A free anonymous token from https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/token, or your Pro key. One token is one data space, and it is refreshed for another 30 days on every write.

asset-register.description: A fixed asset register that depreciates on the rates the tax authorities actually publish, with the schedule, the journal and the gain on sale.
